questions.prompt: Dinner is over and the plates are dirty. Which action do you do in the kitchen?
questions.explanation: Dirty plates go to the sink, and that action is called washing the dishes. Tidying your bed is done in the bedroom, cleaning up the street happens outside with the neighbours, and watering the flowers belongs to the garden.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "My room is ___ . Every book is in its place."
questions.explanation: When everything is in its place, the room is tidy. The word "dirty" says the opposite, that the room needs cleaning, "alone" means with nobody, and "poor" says that somebody has very little money.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "I am the oldest child at home, so I take care of ___ little sister every evening."
questions.explanation: The owner is the person speaking, and the possessive adjective of I is my: my little sister. The forms "I" and "me" are the person who does or receives the action and never stand in front of a noun, and "your" would give the sister to the person you are talking to, when the text says she is in your own house.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "My uncle works in the fields all year. He is a ___ ."
questions.explanation: The person who does the action is the verb plus -er: farm + er = a farmer. The word "farm" names the place, "farming" names the activity, and "farms" is the he form of the verb, so none of the three can name the man himself.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: "Next Monday I ___ the blackboard before the lesson."
questions.explanation: Next Monday is in the future, and the future is will plus the bare verb: I will clean. After will the verb keeps no ending and takes no little word, so "will cleaning", "will cleans" and "will to clean" are all impossible.

questions.prompt: The vet wants you to shut the door of the room. Which sentence is her order?
questions.explanation: An order starts straight with the bare verb and names nobody: Close the door. The forms "Closing the door" and "To close the door" are not whole sentences, and "You close the door" puts a subject in front, which turns the order into a statement about what you do.
